## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated (`uv run pytest`), `ruff` and `mypy` pass
- [ ] Scenes stay pure functions of time (`seek(t)`), no timers or unseeded randomness
- [ ] No real people or private data: photos, phone numbers, screenshots are synthetic or freely licensed and credited
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/storyboard.md`, skills, CHANGELOG)
- [ ] If I bumped an upstream pin, I read the diff (say what you read)
